connector.name: MCP Apple Music
connector.registryDescription: Apple Music MCP server - search catalog, manage playlists, and access your library via Claude.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-apple-music-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cifero74 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Apple MusicKit private key content (ES256, PEM format)

env.name: APPLE_MUSIC_USER_TOKEN
env.description: Apple Music user token for personal library access

env.name: APPLE_STOREFRONT
env.description: Apple Music storefront country code (default: us)
